test_name: RE-friction entry-point-ret-dispatch; CLI and two-pass stage controls
inspiration: RE-friction need entry-point-ret-dispatch on bm3.exe; explicit flow-call override and #504 continuation propagation provide the reference behavior
decisions: Automatic recognition shares the explicit RET-chain recognizer and its existing instruction/site caps; there is no second pattern matcher.
The proof requires an in-run target store plus the adjacent exact fall-through store, and declines at conditional control flow because dominance is unproven.
P-code affine constants are sign-extended by operand width, and overlapping register writes/stores invalidate provenance.
LOAD/STORE facts retain their exact p-code memory-space ID; unsupported CALLOTHER userops clear all provenance.
Explicit flow facts own their sites. Explicit RETURN vetoes a derived CALL without asking the engine to apply RETURN to an instruction already classified as RETURN.
The default-on choice is allowed by 0/675 datatest movement and remains contingent on the recorded speed gate being within 5%.

controls.positive: three-link entry_dispatch plus a one-link two-pass stage bytechunk
controls.negative: ordinary RET, RET-immediate, incoming-address copy, computed/constant RET, discarded continuation, unrelated store, signed negative-displacement overwrite/helper-twice, conditional bypass, partial-SP alias write, cross-space LOAD/STORE pairing, unsupported CALLOTHER between setup and RET
controls.policy: entryretdispatch off restores the old return; explicit flow RETURN cleanly vetoes automatic CALL

speed_note: The mandated option-off/on helper reported a large negative delta on this tiny witness; the result is comfortably within budget but dominated by single-process startup noise. The 25-sample exact-base comparison below is the more useful control.

exact_base_performance.method: one warmup per executable, then 25 post-warmup samples per arm in alternating order; median wall-clock
exact_base_performance.interpretation: The unchanged fauxware control is +0.48%, inside the 5% budget. The two tiny i386 functions show large favorable deltas from process-startup noise; neither indicates a regression.

sweep.method: whole-fixture decompile-all --json, entryretdispatch off versus on
sweep.classification: Only entry_dispatch changes: bare return becomes the three intended calls. Every positive and adversarial negative control is byte-identical.
